narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Teen paav means three kilograms, because teen means three in Hindi.
<bookmark mark='bags'/>Teen does mean three, but each paav is one fourth of a kilogram, not a whole one.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>Three of those fourths still weigh less than one kilogram on the scale.

narration: <bookmark mark='rule'/>Every language has words for fractions, and each word names one fixed amount.
<bookmark mark='turn'/>Your turn, ask at home for the words your family uses for one third and two thirds.
